title: Images in dicts: textures of graphics data and of the renderer to and from a dict
author: Claude-JG
description: There is no conversion of an image (the textures added by SC.renderer.AddTexture and referenced by graphics data) into a dict and back, so a dict of an mbs, the renderer or a Robot cannot carry its textures. Proposed: an image as a dict of its size, interpretation, flags and pixel array, written by the GetDictionary functions and read by SetDictionary and by the HDF5 load and save.
releaseNotes: SC.renderer.GetTexture(name) gives a texture as a dict of name, image (uint8, the first row at the top, as AddTexture takes it), interpretation (its name, e.g. 'RGB') and flags; SC.renderer.GetDictionary and SC.GetDictionary contain all textures under 'textures', and their SetDictionary adds them again; Robot.GetDictionary contains the textures its graphics data name, SetDictionary adds them, so that they are saved with SaveDictToHDF5. A Robot without base or tool, and a RobotBase or RobotTool without visualization, gets its own object instead of one shared by all.
